vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 60s, the person in their 40s, Utpal, Xavier and Sigrun met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 driven off. the person in their 60s, the person in their 40s, Utpal, Xavier, Sigrun are hurt.
🛡️ Anh, Elijah, Henry, Tariq and Maya met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Anh, Elijah, Tariq are hurt.
🛡️ Elijah, Henry, Utpal, Xavier and Sigrun met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Elijah, Utpal, Xavier, Sigrun are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Anh just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elijah, Henry and Utpal met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Utpal is hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Pack-leader Big Loud (×2) and an eye-head (×5) — all here, all now.
Your party: Elijah. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

Your party: Elijah. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Ad Break is still frozen from your scream.
The Pack-leader Ad Break falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Ad Break!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Ad Break, Ad Break (packmate), Sponsor-creature. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Pack-leader Ad Break, Ad Break (packmate), Sponsor-creature.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Elijah SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. The Scarred The Ugly Beast freezes. (stunned)
The Scarred The Ugly Beast is still frozen from your scream.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Ugly Beast!
📺 You brought down Scarred The Ugly Beast. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Tariq was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
Ulzhan: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nathan just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nathan met them at the door — 1 put down.
